verdict.rationale: OpenClaw's docs describe running multiple isolated agents in one Gateway process, each with its own workspace, state directory, auth and session history. Multi-agent routing via channel accounts and bindings is documented. A community user corroborates running 9 agents, each with its own persona. Missing for 10: documentation that each agent can be set to its own model, documentation of per-agent system prompts beyond the community persona anecdote, and detail on how the routing bindings are configured.

support.subject: As a power user, I can run multiple distinct agents with their own prompts, models, and workspaces, and route conversations or channels to each

citations.quote: Run multiple _isolated_ agents in one Gateway process, each with its own workspace, state directory (`agentDir`), and SQLite-backed session history
You want multiple agents with separate workspaces, auth, and sessions in one Gateway process.
Multi-agent routing: agent boundaries, channel accounts, and bindings
they run 9 agents from one machine, schedule tasks, and give each agent a personal persona
